data.code_commit_message:
feat(cpu): add disassembler, interactive debugger, trace and stats output

Implement traceability, debugging & inspection features:
- Disassembler (disasm.h/cpp) for all ANEM16 instruction types
- Interactive debugger (debug.h/cpp) with breakpoints, watchpoints,
  pipeline display, stepping, and REPL
- Execution trace callback with per-cycle disassembly output
- Statistics output with instruction mix, forwarding/stall/bubble counters
- Memory access logging and peripheral enumeration
- HALT instruction detection (0xFFFF) in programEnd()
- PC-per-stage tracking in all pipeline register structs
- CLI flags: -d (debug), -t (trace), -s (stats), -m (max cycles), -h (help)
- Project upgraded to C++20
